page.title: SIEM load
page.description: The load this platform puts on QRadar, and how QRadar itself is doing. Times are UTC.

state.couldNotRead: The SIEM load could not be read.
state.advice: Nothing was changed. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.
state.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
state.forbidden: Your role cannot read the SIEM load (permission <perm>admin:*</perm>). Nothing was changed.
state.refreshFailed: The latest refresh failed{status}. Showing the answer received at <time></time>.
state.refreshRateLimited: too many requests, try again in a minute
state.refreshRateLimitedAfter: too many requests, try again in {seconds, number} s
state.partUnavailable: {part} could not be read, so no figure is shown in its place.

now.heading: Our load on QRadar
now.inFlightNote: A search is stale after {seconds, number} s without an end: its worker probably stopped before it recorded one.
now.slotsConsole: {held, number} console-pool slots held across all consoles, cap {cap, number} each
now.slotsReserved: {reserved, number} kept back for foreground work
now.slotsNotEnforcedNote: No permit cap applies, so no slots are counted.
now.windowsCaption: Searches sent to QRadar in the last 5, 15 and 60 minutes
now.windowsNote: Wall time runs from submit to finish and covers completed searches only; a dash means none completed in the window. Failed counts errors, cancellations, timeouts and searches that found Ariel unavailable. Refused searches were turned away by the permit pool and never reached QRadar.
now.noneSent: No search was submitted in the last 60 minutes.

qradar.heading: QRadar
qradar.noConsoleHelp: QRadar's health is read per enabled console, so there is nothing to show.
qradar.readCached: Cached, {age} old: read at <time></time>. QRadar is asked again after {ttl, number} s.
qradar.epsAllocation: of {allocated} EPS allocated over {hosts, number} hosts: average {average}, peak {peak}
qradar.epsNoShare: Allocation is 0 EPS, so there is no share.
qradar.arielAvailableNote: Judged from this platform's own latest searches, not from a QRadar status.
qradar.arielRecent: {searches, number} searches in the last {minutes, number} min, {unavailable, number} found Ariel unavailable ({share})
qradar.arielHeldNote: Ids QRadar keeps for every user's searches, finished and active. This is what QRadar holds, not what it is running.

flight.heading: Searches in flight
flight.label: Searches in flight
flight.staleGroup: Stale: older than {seconds, number} s. The worker probably stopped before it recorded an end.

summary.heading: Load by caller
summary.label: Load by caller
summary.note: Percentiles cover completed searches only. Totals cover every finished search; a total marked ≥ leaves out searches for which QRadar reported no figure, and a dash means none did. Timeouts are the part of Failed that ran out of time.
summary.emptyTitle: No search was recorded in the last {range}.
summary.emptyHelp: The window holds no recorded search, so there are no figures to show.
summary.couldNotRead: The per-caller summary could not be read.
summary.forbidden: Your role cannot read the per-caller summary (permission <perm>admin:*</perm>). Nothing was changed.
